pairs.name: Conjurer / Dominator
shared: Bipedal humanoid frame and torso broadening at shoulder level
Asymmetric right-arm major energy weapon and free left hand
Medium-size forward armored chest and long articulated shins
differences: Conjurer's elevated small cockpit has twin angled horns, Dominator's cockpit is low and recessed
Dominator has a wide, nearly horizontal left-to-right shoulder line and projected upper shoulder gun; Conjurer shoulders are more separated upright modules
Conjurer has stacked chest facets, Dominator has a pronounced V central breastplate and longer side-facing weapon deck
Dominator long PPC is in lower right forearm with separate left fist, Conjurer's right pulse cannon sits higher on arm

pairs.name: HawkWolf / Black Hawk Standard
shared: Broad shoulders with large arm weapon pods and inset central cockpit
Long two-leg chassis with weapon-bearing forearms and thick shoulder joints
differences: HawkWolf has high, downward-canted paired 15-hole arm missile bricks and two additional 5-hole torso racks; Black Hawk Standard carries 8-hole arm SRM arrays
HawkWolf missile racks visually dominate the height and width of the upper body; Black Hawk Standard has separate raised upper shoulder caps and thinner arms
HawkWolf art has a small high open cockpit and narrow center torso below the rack bank; Black Hawk Standard cockpit is recessed between tall shoulders
